_comment: Coverage ratchet of the critical areas (issue #1247, docs/development/coverage.md).
minimum: the line coverage in percent the area must keep; make coverage-ratchet
and the nightly CI run fail when an area drops more than `tolerance` points below
it, or when a file of the area is not loaded by any test.
When an area rises more than `raise_hint` points above its minimum, the check asks
to raise the value: do that in the same PR as the new tests.
Lowering a minimum is an owner decision: never lower it to make the check pass.
